ORDINANCE IV OF 2006
ORDINANCE IV OF 2006
SINDH ASSEMBLY
MEMBERS, MINISTERS AND
SPECIAL ASSISTANTS TO
THE CHIEF MINISTER
(SALARIES, ALLOWANCES
AND PRIVILEGES)
AMENDING ORDINANCE,
2006
An Ordinance to amend
the laws relating to salaries, allowances
and privileges of the Sindh
Assembly Members, Ministers
and Special Assistants to the Chief Minister
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part I,
9th March, 2006]
No.S.Legis:1(4)/2006, dated
9-3-2006.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh
is hereby published for general information.
Preamble.---Whereas
it is expedient to amend the laws relating to salaries, allowances and
privileges of the Sindh Assembly Members, Ministers
and Special Assistants to the Chief Minister.
And whereas the Provincial Assembly is
not in session and the Governor of Sindh is satisfied
that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 128 of the Constitution of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan the Governor of Sindh is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1)
This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Assembly
Members, Ministers and Special Assistants to the Chief Minister (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) Amending Ordinance, 2005.
(2) It shall come into force at once and
be deemed to have taken effect on and from 1st July, 2005.

2. Amendment of Sindh
Act XXVI of 1974.---In the Sindh
Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1974.
(i) in section 3, for the words "Ten thousand" the
words "fifteen thousand", shall be substituted; and
(ii) after
section 3-A, the following new sections shall be inserted:
3.B. "House
Rent: A member shall be entitled to receive house rent at the rate of ten
thousand rupees per month.
3-C. "Gas and Electricity Charges: A
member shall be entitled to receive gas and electricity charges at the rate of
three thousand rupees per month."
